description: VIVI MUSIC v6.0.8.1 includes download acceleration, in-playlist song search & recommendations, Spotify two-way sync overhaul, offline stability fixes, automatic lyrics pre-fetching, and artist page multi-select.

changelog.title: What's New
items: In-playlist Add Songs menu with search and recommendations based on playlist, listening taste, and followed artists
Multi-select support on artist pages (preview songs, library songs, and online songs)
Automatic background lyrics pre-fetching when playing songs online
Two-way Spotify sync and fixed playlist creation on Spotify profile
Optimized download engine with 512KB CDN range chunking and automated stream search fallback
Fixed offline thumbnail caching with persistent OkHttp cache and headers override
Implemented full Android System UI playback resumption (Spotify-style persistent widget)
Added dormant Quick Settings media panel pinning on OnePlus / OxygenOS
Added automatic queue restoration from disk & database on playback resumption
Added new UI to Listen Together
Added new Remix section in home screen
Added search history box inside search bar
Added new login method by SchmidtiTv (new commit)
Added expressive UI to album image

changelog.title: Fixes & Improvements
items: Fixed swiped-away media widget dismissal by correctly detaching foreground notification on task removed
Fixed MediaLibraryService intent filter actions for MediaBrowser / System UI discovery
Fixed streaming issues thanks to Metrolist
Spoofed app to browser for streaming safety
Added complete Brazilian Portuguese translations by johnpetersa19
